note: Prototype rule set. Each rule is derived from the AICTE Approval Process Handbook 2024-2027 and MUST be mapped to an exact clause, applicability and effective date by a rule owner before any production use. These entries are illustrative and are not a legal interpretation.

rules.title: Lease validity covers the approved academic period
rules.description: The verified lease expiry must not precede the end of the application cycle.
rules.regulatory_reference: APH 2024-2027 land/lease requirement (clause mapping pending verification)

rules.title: Lease document records an issuing authority
rules.description: A lease without a recorded authority is incomplete evidence.
rules.regulatory_reference: APH 2024-2027 document completeness (clause mapping pending verification)

rules.title: Required supporting affidavit is provided
rules.description: Absence of a required document is itself the finding, so this rule declares missing_outcome=FAIL explicitly rather than relying on inference.
rules.regulatory_reference: APH 2024-2027 supporting-document list (clause mapping pending verification)

rules.title: Lease expiry agrees across submitted records
rules.description: Two submitted records state different lease expiry dates. This is a discrepancy to verify, not an accusation.

rules.title: Lessee name matches the applicant institution
rules.description: The lease must name the applicant institution, not a related or third party.
rules.regulatory_reference: APH 2024-2027 institutional identity requirement (clause mapping pending verification)

rules.title: Faculty ratio for existing institutions
rules.description: Applicable only to existing institutions; demonstrates NOT_APPLICABLE for new applicants.
rules.regulatory_reference: APH 2024-2027 faculty requirement (clause mapping pending verification)

rules.title: No follow-up promise is late
rules.description: The college's outstanding undertakings (post-approval conditions it must keep) must all be within their due dates before a fresh approval is recorded. Waived or verified undertakings do not count.
rules.regulatory_reference: APH 2024-2027 post-approval compliance conditions (clause mapping pending verification)
